sources.title: RoboTwin 2.0
sources.snippet: RoboTwin 2.0 is a scalable framework for data generation and benchmarking in bimanual robotic manipulation. It integrates an expert data generation pipeline and a 50-task benchmark built on the RoboTwin Object Dataset (731 objects, 147 categories).
